column1: # PreToolUse stdin shapes per https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (read 2026-10-05): the common fields,
# plus agent_id/agent_type inside a subagent. The harness sets no active_skill field; where a fixture carries
# tool_input.active_skill it is what a model-authored tool_input can contain. __ROOT__ is the test project root.
# Decisions with no RUNNING state in .run/: "ask" = the gate emits {"decision":"ask"}, "allow" = silent exit 0.
# records_evidence: the lead-session recorder writes active_skill_seen_at (yes) or nothing (no).
